question: How is the goddess Śūlinī identified and honored in this declaration?
premises: Śūlinī is named as the deity.
She is explicitly declared to be the goddess.
She is described as adored by all gods.
inference: Śūlinī is declared to be the goddess who is adored by all the gods.
plain_english: Thus Śūlinī is declared to be the goddess, adored by all the gods.
